name: House of Representatives
notes: 596 seats: 284 individual, 284 list and 28 appointed by the President, elected in late 2025. Who sits is from the House's own list of members in office (parliament.gov.eg); the site gives names in Arabic and the way each seat was filled, not the party, so seats are grouped that way. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Senate of Egypt
notes: 300 seats: 200 elected (100 by list, 100 individual) and 100 appointed by the President, from 2025. No complete list of members could be found (senate.gov.eg did not answer), so this chart shows only the members Wikidata records for the 2025 Senate, about a third; the other seats show as 'Not named', which is not the same as vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
